## Install

Download `mantis-mrxsconvert-<version>-all.jar` below, drag it onto the QuPath window, then restart QuPath.
Requires **QuPath 0.7.x on Windows 10/11 (x64)**. See the [README](https://github.com/Embodied-Space/mantis-mrxsconvert#readme) for how to use it.

## What's inside

The jar bundles unmodified copies of these programs, which do the conversion:

- [bioformats2raw 0.12.1](https://github.com/glencoesoftware/bioformats2raw/tree/v0.12.1) (Glencoe Software, GPL-2.0)
- [raw2ometiff 0.10.1](https://github.com/glencoesoftware/raw2ometiff/tree/v0.10.1) (Glencoe Software, GPL-2.0)
- [Eclipse Temurin JRE 25.0.4.1+1](https://github.com/adoptium/jdk25u/tree/jdk-25.0.4.1+1_adopt) (GPL-2.0 with the Classpath Exception)

Their license texts and third-party notices are extracted with them, to
`%LOCALAPPDATA%\mantis-mrxsconvert\tools\<id>\LICENSES\` and `…\jre\legal\`.
The extension itself is licensed under GPL-3.0.
